<!-- pr-reviewer: 92430ff036f80d609d4f0bff05e1e8ab100f0034 -->

Independent review of head `92430ff036f80d609d4f0bff05e1e8ab100f0034`. The review built the test binary and ran the guard test. Result: clean.

**What the reviewer checked.**

- The diff against `main` changes two files: one heading in `site/content/guide/reference/troubleshooting.md`, and the new file `docs/decisions/2051-troubleshooting-stem.md`. The diff changes no code in `crates/`. The guard `crates/app/tests/docs_troubleshooting.rs` is unchanged.
- The head already contains `main` (31f8d03d7). `git merge origin/main` reported "Already up to date". There is no conflict.
- The new heading quotes the message as the app prints it. The stems `imported incomplete` and `so it has walls missing and no gouge check against it can be trusted` are literal text in the format string in `crates/app/src/mesh_open.rs` (line 75, `incomplete`). The prefix `model '<model>' was` comes from the same file: the refusal builds it at line 382 with `unknown_note`. The page still describes the message a user sees.
- Test `troubleshooting_messages_still_exist_in_the_sources` (camcraft-app, binary `docs_troubleshooting`): passed. 1 passed, 0 failed.
- The PR body has the `Changelog:` line and the closing line for the issue. The commit body ends with the closing line.
- The decision file follows the format in `docs/decisions/README.md`.

**Minor note. This is not a blocker.** The decision file cites commit `35b422cf`. That commit does not exist in the repository. The real commit is `35b3422cf` (fix(import): load a STEP closed shell that meshes open as an incomplete model). Please correct the citation in a push on this branch, or record it for a follow-up. Do not let it hold the merge.

**What was not run.** The other camcraft-app suites, clippy, and the heavy lanes. The change touches no code, so those lanes cover nothing new. The post-merge run on `main` covers the rest.

Label set: `merge-ready`.
